description: Fix backend notification trigger logic in Convex (issues #45 problems 2-4) and fix notification payload (problem 5). Changes to convex/sync/waterLevelUpdater.ts and convex/notifications.ts.
steps: Create branch fix/r5-notifications from main: `git checkout -b fix/r5-notifications`

In convex/sync/waterLevelUpdater.ts, replace the risingToDanger detection logic. Remove the `previousAlertLevel` and `risingToDanger` variables. Replace with: `const shouldNotifyDanger = alertLevel === 3;`. Then add a staleness check before scheduling: `const STALENESS_MS = 2_700_000; const isDataStale = updatedAt ? (Date.now() - new Date(updatedAt).getTime() > STALENESS_MS) : true;`. Change the scheduling condition from `if (risingToDanger)` to `if (shouldNotifyDanger && !isDataStale)`. This fixes problems 2 (first insert at danger), 3 (sustained danger re-notification after cooldown), and 4 (stale data should not notify).

In convex/notifications.ts, in the buildNotificationPayload function, change the content message from `Station ${stationName} has reached danger level (${currentLevel}m)` (with optional updatedAt suffix) to simply `${stationName} has reached Danger level. Check the app for details.`. Remove the `if (updatedAt)` block that appends the time. Keep the headings as 'Danger Level Alert'.
acceptance_criteria: convex/sync/waterLevelUpdater.ts uses `const shouldNotifyDanger = alertLevel === 3` instead of the previous risingToDanger logic
A staleness check (STALENESS_MS = 2_700_000) prevents notifications for stale data
convex/notifications.ts buildNotificationPayload content is `${stationName} has reached Danger level. Check the app for details.` without the raw elevation or updatedAt suffix
verification: Run `bun run build` and confirm it passes with no TypeScript errors
findings: Build passes (tsc && vite build). Lint at exactly 71 problems (baseline). Removed unused destructured variables (currentLevel, updatedAt) from buildNotificationPayload to keep lint clean. Branch fix/r5-notifications created from main with single commit.
